run_sandbox_api_server: run the open-terminal sandbox API server with custom host, port, and API key options
run_mcp_server_stdio: run the MCP server using stdio transport for terminal-based interaction
run_mcp_server_streamable_http: run the MCP server using streamable-http transport with custom host and port
run_server_with_config: run the sandbox API server loading settings from a TOML config file
run_server_with_cors: run the sandbox API server with restricted CORS allowed origins for production
